breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that K affects only the mode shape and instructed using π²EI/L² (without K) for the Euler load. The generated specification correctly applies K directly in the Euler buckling formula as P_cr = π²EI/(KL)², computing the effective length as KL = 0.5 × 3000 = 1500 mm and using it in the denominator. This matches the ground truth prompt's correct treatment of K.
